New York: on Ezra Feldstein's bench, a one-carat natural diamond, G colour VS1, at a median of about $4,400 on a price tracker he read on 31 October; the same 6.5 mm stone in moissanite listed at $810 on a ring maker's page. A heat-pen tester beeps 'diamond' for both. An electrical tester lights yellow for the moissanite and green for the diamond, and under a tilted loupe the moissanite shows doubled facet edges. Ezra Feldstein has spent 40 years on 47th Street.

Video: Ezra Feldstein, YouTube, 10 Nov 2026. Sources: the prices as spoken on the tape (a price tracker and a ring maker's page, both read by the jeweller; neither named on the tape).
